notes.title: Gamepad support + minor bugfixes
notes.content:
It's a little janky in places but all menus now support xbox pads. I had to make the analogue sticks or dpad control the mouse directly in places.

bugs fixed
[list]
[*] Gamepad movement is no longer faster moving left or right
[*] The B button works to go back in menu's where you cant highlight the back button
[*] The shop refund button now actually refunds everything (you could stack regen and rerolls by refunding and buying it again)

[/list]
